messages:
sam: Quick report from a workshop: several attendees hit 403s when copying the example image curl in /guides/runtime/setup. Seems the examples use an ephemeral short.redwood link.

viv: Thanks for the catch. Shortlinks were convenient but they expire after credential rotations. Which exact snippet?

sam: The 'verify assets' code block (third snippet). It contains `curl https://short.redwood/static/onboarding.png -O` and fails for about half the room.

harper: Oof. That breaks teachables. My vote: replace with `/assets/docs/runtime/onboarding.png` so the example is durable across buckets.

viv: Agreed. Also +1 to adding a docs lint rule to flag `short.redwood` inside fenced code blocks so we don't regress. We could also add a small migration PR to sweep remaining occurrences.

sam: low-risk patch is ideal. Could we do: 1) sed replace in the one file 2) open a follow-up sweep PR that uses ripgrep to find short.redwood and replace with asset mapping?

harper: yep. I'll open the micro PR for the single-file fix and include a note in the commit message recommending the sweep.

doclint-bot: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4629 title: "docs(runtime): replace ephemeral shortlink in onboarding example" assignee: harper.

viv: Can someone from eng-runtime review quickly? @harper can you ping the runtime owner in the PR description so they can preview staging?

harper: done. PR description includes staging check steps and a preview link. Also added a follow-up issue link: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/issues/1298 "lint: detect short.redwood in codeblocks"

sam: Thanks both. If the PR lands, can we also update the workshop notes to prefer copying from the rendered page (not raw markdown) to avoid odd escape issues? Small UX nudge.

harper: added a one-line note in the workshop doc.

doclint-bot: PR merged by viv 1: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4629 1 deployed to staging.

sam: Verified staging preview — image loads and `curl` works for attendees. Closing the loop, and opening a separate thread to discuss the lint rule ETA. Thanks! :thumbsup:
